scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init api
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop postgres redis minio api
scripts.deploy:admin: docker compose build admin && docker compose up -d --no-deps admin
scripts.deploy:api: docker compose build api && docker compose up -d --no-deps api
scripts.deploy:worker: docker compose build worker && docker compose up -d --no-deps worker
scripts.deploy:nginx: docker compose build nginx && docker compose up -d --no-deps nginx
